targeting.title: n8n Loop Over Items: Batch Size, Done Branch, Reset and Rate Limits
targeting.metaTitle: n8n Loop Over Items: Batches, Done Branch, Fixes
targeting.metaDescription: How the n8n Loop Over Items node works: batch size, loop and done outputs, Reset, noItemsLeft, nested loops, rate limits, and fixes for loops that stop early.
targeting.excerpt: A source-verified guide to the n8n Loop Over Items node: when you need it, what the loop and done outputs emit on each run, batch size, index and last batch detection, Reset, nested loops, rate limits versus HTTP Request batching, and fixes for loops that run once or never finish.
targeting.keywords: n8n loop over items, n8n loop over items example, n8n loop over items batch size, n8n loop over items not working, n8n loop over items done branch, n8n loop over items reset, n8n split in batches, n8n nested loop, n8n rate limit, n8n loop over items index
targeting.summary: The node is only needed for nodes that run once, for pacing API calls and for chunking; n8n iterates everything else itself|The done output returns the items that flowed back into the node, so a missing loop-back means done never runs|Prefer HTTP Request Batching and Pagination for rate limits and pages; use Reset only for pagination or nested loops with a tested exit
targeting.author: Ali Rehman
